text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here's a question for ya! What dish, 
packed with sauce and bonito flakes, is 
near and dear to our hearts?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Sauce and bonito flakes... Nature-san 
and me? Umm—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Could it be... Kokura yaki udon... 
or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, just as expected~! I figured you 
might be craving that taste right about 
now. So I thought, how about it as a 
birthday present~?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! That... makes me really happy! I 
was just starting to miss it, actually.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I just knew that's how it'd be, ya 
know~ Just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Oh, even using the dialect... Somehow... 
it takes me back to where I started.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Me too. Whenever I think of Kokura and 
look back on how I ran back then, it's 
like I get a boost of energy!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Could it be... that's why you gave me 
yakiudon...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To remember my original resolve... and 
push myself to work even harder...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Nature-san. —No, your 
insight is seriously amazing, honestly. It 
really encourages me...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you're giving me way too much 
credit! Well... as long as you're happy, 
that's what matters most!
